# Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall, query logging and runtime

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend the records-only endpoint, rule and association slice with separate advanced control-plane and truthful DNS execution contracts.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] DNS Firewall rule groups and associations
- [ ] Resolver query logging configurations and associations
- [ ] Resolver/DNSSEC configuration and sharing policies
- [ ] IPv6, delegation, protocols, endpoint address mutations and list filters
- [ ] Stable AWS-managed Internet Resolver rules
- [ ] Real DNS forwarding, network/IP allocation and lifecycle readiness

## Integration decisions

Current endpoint, rule and VPC association APIs store records only. DNS and network runtime require separate implementation.
